label_provenance: Eight additional frames labeled by Codex from timestamped sheets. Destination identity is user-confirmed. These are provisional frame labels, not accepted episode-level training labels, human labels, or a held-out reliability estimate. The legacy evaluator field user_outcome contains the explicitly non-user episode description above.

52.outcome: Codex sampled frame review; no new user-confirmed episode outcome
52.prompt: pick drink bottle and place it on the right table
52.completion_criteria: The target drink bottle has moved from the source table to the separate green stool, which is the registered right-table destination, and the robot has released it. The bottle must visibly rest on that stool. A bottle remaining on the source table does not count. A held or occluded bottle, or an unseen destination, does not establish completion. Identify the destination by its appearance, not by which side of the camera image it occupies.
